models_evaluated: QuPath automated Masson's trichrome fibrosis quantification algorithm

links.outcome: Inter-observer agreement among pathologists before versus after seeing AI quantification of myocardial fibrosis
links.effect: Three pathologists reassessed fibrosis after seeing the algorithm output; overall agreement improved significantly and no longer depended on fibrosis severity. Algorithm median 13.60% vs first pathologist 8.33% (R2 0.79).
links.quote: The knowledge of the automatic quantification significantly improved the overall pathologist´s agreement, which became unaffected by the degree of MF severity.

links.effect: Interobserver discordance was relevant, particularly for higher percentages of MF.

links.effect: Pathologist-AI quantification was highly correlated (R2: 0.79; p < 0.001); AI knowledge significantly improved overall pathologist agreement.
